notes: Sheet is rotated: north is to the LEFT (east up, west down). McMillan runs page-vertical at the left edge with only its south line on the paper (x~472 at the top to ~498 at the bottom); McMillan points are south line - 30 ft. Salutaris Av. runs along the top from McMillan to the right edge, with WOOD STEPS in its roadway from x~5557 to the edge; it becomes BROOKLYN (printed on sheets 328 and 332) at Carondolet. Grandview Av. (40') and Highland Av. (IN EAST WALNUT HILLS, 60') run from McMillan to the right edge (sheet 328/329); Minnehaha Av. (30') from Fleming to the right edge. Fleming (50') runs from Grandview across Highland onto sheet 326. CARONDOLET and CLARENDON are printed without a suffix; 'Street' added, as for McMillan, Fleming and Brooklyn. The ~11 ft unnamed strip from the top edge to Salutaris at x~5400-5570 (running parallel to Carondolet along the north side of the Carondolet lots on sheet 332) is recorded as an alley stub. The top-right corner (Carondolet, Clarendon, Brooklyn steps) overlaps the top-left of sheet 328. Lines at x~3028 (block 1), x~5590 and y~1780 are lot lines. Points within ~15 px; McMillan points depend on the printed 60' (+/-20 px).
